hook: A short Thaumiel file in which the Foundation has built something and spends almost the entire article hiding it. The procedures are a long stack of layered defences; save your attention for the last paragraph of the description, which changes how all of them read.
whyItMatters: It flips the usual setup: the cognitohazard was made in-house by the Counter-Intelligence Agency and the Memetics Division, and it is guarded as an asset rather than contained as a threat. The procedures roll through a wide range of Foundation hardware, from Scranton Reality Anchors and devices against divine intervention to the Samsara task force's construction tanks, which conveys how much is being spent on one object. The Global Occult Coalition is cast as the rival the whole arrangement is built against.
thingsToNotice: The description is brief: perceiving 73% or more of the inscription instantly shuts down every neurological function in any sentient being, and surviving would need a cognitive resistance value of 742 on a logarithmic scale, so inoculation is considered out of reach. Then the last line reveals its record since 2023: at least eight thousand omniscient entities neutralized, two thousand or more of them employed by the GOC. Read the procedures again after that line and they look different: sixteen identical chambers with decoys, a rule that no one may know which holds the real one, an order to destroy it if the GOC seizes it, and the training data burned. The article never states the mechanism outright and leaves the reader to put those pieces together.
